name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Grip the bar about shoulder width, no narrower
Pin your shoulder blades back and down
Lower the bar with your elbows tucked near your sides
Touch your lower chest and press back up over your shoulders
Stack your wrists over your elbows
